item.description: Welcome! IP Networks I’ve built and operated various autonomous systems: AS30746 Started in 2003, my personal network, 18 years old - now just our home. AS61220 Treffgarne amateur radio repeater site. AS60035 My ASN for experiments. AS60036 Pembs Wifi from 2015 which I started with my business partner. We built 15 network PoPs, delivered broadband to the local community via fixed wireless and self dug fibre.
